notes: The subway costs 3 USD with OMNY contactless; after 12 rides in a week, further rides are free. Get to JFK by AirTrain plus LIRR or the E train; a taxi is a flat 70 USD.
Museums: the Met is 30 USD for visitors from outside New York, the Natural History Museum 28 USD, MoMA 30 USD; many offer 'pay what you wish' on certain days.
Summers are humid, 28-33°C: head to Coney Island and the riverside parks, and Broadway in the evening. There are fireworks on 4 July.
Tip 18-22% in restaurants and 1-2 USD per drink at bars; prices exclude tax (8.9%).
Bagels, slice pizza, pastrami and halal carts: 5-15 USD; a sit-down meal is 30+ USD.
Book the first Statue of Liberty ferry and crown tickets months ahead; Top of the Rock tickets are timed.

transit.name: OMNY (contactless)
transit.why_chosen: Pay 3 USD per ride on the subway and buses with a contactless card; after 12 rides in a week, the rest are free
transit.where_to_buy: Kendi temassız kartın; OMNY kartı marketlerde 1 USD

days.theme: Midtown: Empire State, Bryant Park, Times Square

stops.name: Top of the Rock
stops.tips: Rockefeller Center's observation deck: the best view of the Empire State Building. Timed tickets (~47 USD); clearest in the morning.

stops.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
stops.tips: Neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue; free entry.

stops.name: Ess-a-Bagel
stops.tips: A proper New York bagel: everything bagel with scallion cream cheese. The queue moves fast.

stops.name: New York Public Library & Bryant Park
stops.tips: The Rose Main Reading Room is free; take a lunch break in the park.

stops.name: Times Square
stops.tips: Best after dark, when the lights are on. Buy discounted same-day Broadway tickets at TKTS.

backups.name: Empire State Building
backups.tips: The 86th-floor deck; the classic alternative to Top of the Rock.

backups.name: Los Tacos No. 1 Times Square
backups.tips: Adobada tacos (marinated pork); the best quick bite in Times Square.

stops.name: Statue of Liberty Ferry Battery Park
stops.tips: The first Statue City Cruises ferry leaves at 08:30 (~26 USD, pedestal access included). Ellis Island has an immigration museum. Book crown tickets months ahead.

stops.name: 9/11 Memorial
stops.tips: The twin tower pools; free to visit, museum ~33 USD.

stops.name: Oculus & Westfield World Trade Center
stops.tips: Calatrava's white station; great for photos.

stops.name: Joe's Pizza Broadway
stops.tips: New York slice pizza: fold it and eat it standing up.

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge Walk
stops.tips: Walk from Manhattan to Brooklyn across the bridge in 30 minutes, then head to DUMBO for sunset.

backups.name: Staten Island Ferry
backups.tips: A free ferry: see the Statue of Liberty from the water without going up to the pedestal.

backups.name: Eataly Downtown
backups.tips: An Italian food market at the World Trade Center.

stops.name: Central Park South Tour
stops.tips: Bethesda Terrace, Bow Bridge and Strawberry Fields; rowing boats in summer.

stops.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
stops.tips: The Egyptian temple, Vermeer and the American Wing. 30 USD for visitors from outside New York; allow at least 2 hours.

stops.name: Levain Bakery Upper West Side
stops.tips: Giant cookies, right by Central Park.

stops.name: American Museum of Natural History
stops.tips: Dinosaurs and the blue whale; ~28 USD for visitors from outside New York.

backups.name: Guggenheim Museum
backups.tips: Frank Lloyd Wright's spiral; an alternative to the Natural History Museum.

stops.name: DUMBO Washington Street
stops.tips: The classic Manhattan Bridge view; no crowds in the morning.

stops.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
stops.tips: A riverside park with Jane's Carousel and the Manhattan skyline.

stops.name: Juliana's Pizza
stops.tips: Coal-oven pizza in DUMBO from the original Grimaldi's pizzaiolo. Opens at 11:30.

stops.name: Williamsburg Bedford Avenue
stops.tips: Vintage shops, record stores and cafes; take the L train.

stops.name: Domino Park
stops.tips: A riverside park on a former sugar refinery site, with Manhattan sunsets.

backups.name: Brooklyn Heights Promenade
backups.tips: A scenic walkway in front of the brownstone houses.

days.theme: High Line, Chelsea and Greenwich Village

stops.name: The High Line
stops.tips: A park on a former railway line; walk from Gansevoort Street to 34th Street. Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Chelsea Market
stops.tips: A food market in the old Nabisco factory; try Los Tacos No. 1 and a lobster roll.

stops.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
stops.tips: American art, plus terraces with views of the High Line.

stops.name: Washington Square Park
stops.tips: The arch and street musicians; NYU's neighbourhood.

stops.name: Greenwich Village Walk
stops.tips: Bleecker Street, the Friends building and a Magnolia Bakery cupcake.

backups.name: Joe's Pizza Carmine Street
backups.tips: The original Joe's, in the Village.

backups.name: Little Island
backups.tips: An artificial island park over the river; an alternative to the Whitney.

stops.name: Coney Island Boardwalk
stops.tips: 1 hour by subway; the boardwalk, the Cyclone (~10 USD) and the Wonder Wheel.

stops.name: Nathan's Famous Coney Island
stops.tips: Hot dogs since 1916; home of the famous eating contest.

stops.name: Coney Island Beach
stops.tips: Swim in the Atlantic; bring a towel and sunscreen.

stops.name: New York Aquarium
stops.tips: An aquarium on the boardwalk.

backups.name: Brighton Beach
backups.tips: The beach of the neighbouring Russian district.

days.theme: Lower East Side: a gentle farewell

stops.name: Russ & Daughters
stops.tips: Lox and bagels since 1914; the perfect farewell breakfast.

stops.name: Tenement Museum
stops.tips: A guided tour of an immigrant tenement building; book ahead.

stops.name: Little Italy Mulberry Street
stops.tips: Cannoli (at Ferrara) and the Italian quarter.

stops.name: Chinatown Canal Street
stops.tips: Souvenirs and dim sum; try Nom Wah Tea Parlor.

stops.name: Penn Station / AirTrain
stops.tips: AirTrain plus LIRR to JFK takes 45 minutes; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Clinton St. Baking Company
backups.tips: Pancake breakfast, instead of Russ & Daughters.
